description: React component for a minimal, DOM-based map visualization with markers, pan/zoom controls, route plotting, and popups. It uses internal functions for projection and handles user interactions like wheel zoom and drag panning.

methods.name: project
methods.description: Calculates x, y positions for map coordinates based on center, zoom, and size.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Restricts a value within min and max bounds.

methods.name: projectStyle
methods.description: Generates style object for marker positioning.

methods.name: projectPopupStyle
methods.description: Generates style object for popup positioning.
